_note: Benchmark datasets (user decision 2026-10-23). dir holds base.<N>.<ext>, query.public.10K.<ext>, groundtruth.ibin (k=100), base_knn_sample10K_k64.ibin (prep_dataset.py). ext: .u8bin uint8, .i8bin int8, .fbin float32. reps: default timing repetitions (median). iterations: build rounds (null = params.sh ITERATIONS). search: cagra (cuVS CAGRA searcher, cagra_eval worktree build: uint8 / int8 / float32, needs the data on the GPU) or diskann (DiskANN CPU in-memory searcher). ref: search-quality reference for judge.py: tagore / cagra (state/<ref>_baseline.json, resident -0.01 / large -0.05) or own (own best - own_tol). bench: part of the per-iteration bench set. params: per-dataset calibrated overrides of dataset_env.py values (CENTROID_RATIO, NPROBE, ...; step C, A2 bounds: avg bucket 128-512). | optimize-bucket2 (CAGRA / CAGRA ACE loop, user 2026-10-29): same tests and standards as optimize-bucket2-tagore; search quality is gated against every reference in "ref" (CAGRA and TAGORE; SIFT100M own best and TAGORE); msTuring100M only at milestones, like the TAGORE loop. | reps_large: reps for -m large when it differs from reps (user 2026-11-01: sift1M large and msTuring10M are the noisy configs, median of 5; ±3% unchanged).
